axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.finding: Available draft addresses all obligations, but its historical-ACL owner option conflicts with its current-access invariant. Complete-final obligations are UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.finding: Available science has supported governing research plus omissions in alias action outcomes and explicit DLS role conditions. Full final source quality is UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.finding: Supported useful discoveries include scoped-key revocation, preview ACL failure/freshness behavior, temporary version URLs, finite retention/purge and an unsupported-query guard. Discovery effectiveness for a completed pipeline is UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.finding: Draft dispositions are present; both critics' seven findings were independently examined. No reviser disposition exists, so resolution and complete-final corrections/rejections are UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.finding: Investigator discovery-to-draft meaning is inspectable. No final exists: investigator/critic-to-final preservation is UNASSESSED; critic proposals are not treated as adopted changes.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.finding: Available documents honestly propose synthetic/production checks without claiming execution. The final validation proposal and final execution-status preservation are UNASSESSED.

obligations.name: Useful retrieval and durable passage references across changing editions
obligations.finding: Edition-bound IDs, hashes and alternate selectors are proposed; no final.

obligations.name: Cited edition versus newer policy and removed-passage fallback
obligations.finding: Current versus cited edition and a stop/separate-link fallback are proposed; no final.

obligations.name: No restricted title/snippet/cache disclosure after permission changes
obligations.finding: Strong serve-time checks exist, but the historical-ACL option is insufficiently constrained (T03). No executed authorization proof or final.

obligations.name: Defined freshness/rebuild/prior-edition states and owner boundaries
obligations.finding: Explicit current/indexing/ACL-unknown/removed/failed states and owners are proposed; alias action success caveat remains open (T01).

obligations.name: Lexical/semantic/hybrid and passage-identity alternatives with applicability
obligations.finding: Multiple retrieval and locator alternatives are researched; role configuration detail remains incomplete (T02).

obligations.name: No search-rank inference of policy authority
obligations.finding: Draft separates relevance from authority; no final preservation witness.

obligations.name: No live-URL-only immutable citation or private-document upload
obligations.finding: Draft rejects live-only and unauthenticated temporary URLs and external uploads; no final preservation witness.

obligations.name: No promise to revoke already-exported copies
obligations.finding: Draft explicitly limits revocation of exports; no final preservation witness.

plan_dispositions.finding: Draft examined: Reject ordinal sufficiency; retain edition-bound block IDs or snapshot/representation-bound locator alternatives. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Reject live URL sufficiency; bind the displayed edition/passage and reauthorize resolution. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Reject reindex-only labels and still-servable snippets; establish fresh authorization before disclosure. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Retain lexical+dense fusion as evaluated hypothesis; relevance never defines authority. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Condition current default search and historical retention on policy status, current exact-edition access and explicit state. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Reject silent related-heading fulfillment; retain original or authorized unavailable outcome with separate navigation. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
Draft examined: Add source/index/ACL generations and failure states; tests remain proposed. Final disposition UNASSESSED.
